side-01-c2.text: Paul C. Kocher (1996). Timing Attacks on Implementations of Diffie-Hellman, RSA, DSS, and Other Systems. Advances in Cryptology (CRYPTO '96), LNCS 1109, Springer.
side-01-c2.quote: By carefully measuring the amount of time required to perform private key operations, attackers may be able to find fixed Diffie-Hellman exponents, factor RSA keys, and break other cryptosystems.
side-01-c2.claim: The field as we know it began with a 1996 paper by Paul Kocher, Timing Attacks on Implementations of Diffie-Hellman, RSA, DSS, and Other Systems.
